4. It appears that, the plaintiffs has produced 6 witnesses namely, PWs 1-6 and also produced certain documents which have been marked as Exhibit 1 to 5, 5, 5(Ka), 6, 6(Ka), 7, 7(Ka), 8, 8(Ka), 9, 9(Ka). The certified copy of CS khatian No. 69 (Exhibit), 3 original title deeds (exhibit 2-4) and the certified Copy of the SA and RS khatian (Exhibit 5 and 6 series), respectively. Besides, Exhibit 7 is also an original deed No. 1767 dated 4-4-1994, Exhibit 7(Ka) to 9(Ka) are the signatures of the PWs No. 3 to 5, who are the deed writers. Having examined the order sheet of the trial court, I find that, the defendant, did not adduce any oral or documentary evidence. 

 24. I have given emphasis to the submission of the learned Advocates for the opposite party that, the plaintiffs ought to have given reference to RS and BS plot number in their plaint, but I find that, the plaintiffs have submitted the certified copy of the CS, SA and RS khatinas, respectively marked as Exhibit 1, 5 and 6 series. The defendant did not appear even to cross-examine the plaintiff's witnesses on the oral evidence or documentary evidences to prove that the boundary or description of the suit property was not correct or that any property of the Union Parishad were lying within the suit property described in the schedule to the plaint. Therefore, this objection is not sustainable in view of the fact and these khatians were available to ascertain if the suit property, at all included any property of the Union Parishad and as to whether any saham was claimed in respect of any property owed by the Union Parishad. Even, the defendant did not put any written objection, inspite of taking 17 adjournments against the warrant of delivery of possession. As such, the executing court has rightly disposed of the execution case by order No. 49 dated 15-10-2015, as has been annexed to the revisional application.
